latest_release.name: v19.6.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- Adds review sessions to the _Commit Graph_'s _Review Changes_ mode — a review is now something you work through, with or without AI, rather than a one-off AI report
  - Adds a checklist of the changed files that tracks what you've viewed and brings back any file that changes afterward
  - Adds reading controls to the diff editor that step through the review's files not yet viewed (<kbd>Alt</kbd>+click steps in list order)
  - Adds comment threads in the diff for AI findings and your own comments — reply to them, dismiss them, or hand them to your agent
  - Adds _Orient_ beside _Review Diff_ — _Orient_ has AI plan the order to read the files in, while _Review Diff_ finds issues in the diff
  - Adds _Review in Repo_ — hands the changes to your CLI agent, which can build, test and trace call paths in the repository and streams its findings back into the review
  - Adds _Uncommitted_, _Unpushed_ and _Branch_ presets to the review's scope picker — one click to review your uncommitted changes, those plus the commits not pushed yet, or the whole branch
  - Keeps a review going when you amend or rebase — its viewed marks, findings and comments move to the rewritten commits, and an open diff switches to the new changes in place
- Adds GitHub merge queue support — a pull request waiting in a merge queue shows as queued instead of open, and _Merge_ adds it to the queue when its base branch merges only through one ([#5991](https://github.com/gitkraken/vscode-gitlens/issues/5991))
  - Shows a queued pull request's place in the queue, its status, and its estimated merge time in hovers, views, autolinks, _Launchpad_, and the _Commit Graph_ — and when the queue removes one, says so and why
  - Adds _Add to Merge Queue_ and _Remove from Merge Queue_ to _Launchpad_ and the _Commit Graph_ — a queued pull request can also be removed from the "already in the merge queue" notification
  - Adds an _In Merge Queue_ group to _Launchpad_ — pull requests failing in the queue, or just removed from it by a failed run, show under _Blocked_
  - Rechecks a queued pull request while the _Commit Graph_ shows it, so the Graph catches up when the queue merges or removes it
  - Holds back _Merge_, _Rebase Stack_, and branch-changing next steps (push, rebase or merge with the merge target, recompose) in the _Commit Graph_ and _Launchpad_ while a pull request is queued — the queue owns its branch until it merges or leaves
  - Adds a `gitlens.queuedPullRequestIconColor` theme color for queued pull requests
- Adds cleanup actions for branches whose work has already landed ([#3896](https://github.com/gitkraken/vscode-gitlens/issues/3896)) — when a branch's pull request was merged, or Git shows its work is in the merge target, the merge target status, the _Commit Graph_'s branch details, overview and working changes next steps lead with deleting the branch instead of offering _Publish_, _Rebase_, _Merge_ or _Create Pull Request_
  - Recognizes a merged pull request even after its branch was deleted on the remote, and pre-selects _Force Delete_ only when a merged pull request proves the work landed
  - Shows a branch with commits after its merged pull request as having new commits since, with an option to create a pull request for them
  - Leads with _Delete Local Branch_, with _Publish_ as the fallback, for a branch that is missing from the remote and hasn't landed
- Adds installing Kepler right from GitLens, with no admin rights needed — _Install Kepler_ downloads and verifies the latest Kepler and installs it for you, showing its progress
  - Adds _Install Kepler_ and _Learn More_ to the _Try Kepler_ banners in _GitLens Settings_ and the _Commit Graph_'s _Agents_ sidebar, and to the Kepler step of the _Welcome_ view walkthrough; adds a _GitLens: Install Kepler_ command
  - Replaces the "Kepler isn't installed" warning with a picker that offers to install Kepler and then carrie
